column1: # One agent run per distinct `run`. A run owns one or more status lines in
# docs/site/00-status.md; the runner gates on every label it owns and, when a
# label is PASS, on the artifacts listed for it (comma-separated).
# `when` is all | store | content. It decides which runs apply to this site, not
# whether the capability exists. A content site skips 2b/3/4c and marks them
